# EulerPilot Reference Snapshot

Reduced reference snapshot copied from local repositories.

- `libbpf-bootstrap/examples/c`: C/libbpf examples for CO-RE, ringbuf, tracepoints, TC and related eBPF patterns.
- `lmp`: Linux Microscope overview, eBPF Hub template, eBPF Visualization README and eBPF Supermarket README.
- `papers/2602.09345v2.pdf`: paper snapshot added as project reference material.

Use this as reference material only.
